*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Get SDOC_CONTAINER ***************************************************************************************************************************************
DATA(lo_goal_sdoc_data_cont) = cl_goal_sdoc_data_cont=>get_instance( ). *************************************************************************************************************************************** *Create sales order ***************************************************************************************************************************************

TRY. CALL METHOD cl_goal_api=>so_instance->create EXPORTING iv_bo_id = if_goal_sdoc=>co_bo_id-salesorder is_load_parameter = ls_load_param io_data_container = lo_goal_sdoc_data_cont RECEIVING ro_access = lo_access. lv_handle_head = cl_goal_util=>so_instance->create_guid( ). APPEND VALUE #( entity_id = 'HEAD' handle = lv_handle_head ) TO lt_handle_reuse. lo_access->set_handle_reuse( lt_handle_reuse ). CATCH cx_goal_exc INTO lx_goal_exc. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lx_goal_exc->get_text( ) }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDTRY.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Set head ***************************************************************************************************************************************
CLEAR ls_head_data. ls_head_data-handle = lv_handle_head. ls_head_data-sold_to_party_id = '0010100001'.
CLEAR ls_changed_field. ls_changed_field-handle = ls_head_data-handle. lv_field = 'SOLD_TO_PARTY_ID'. INSERT lv_field INTO TABLE ls_changed_field-field.
TRY. CALL METHOD lo_access->set_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id is_entity_data = ls_head_data is_changed_field = ls_changed_field. CATCH cx_goal_exc INTO lx_goal_exc. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lx_goal_exc->get_text( ) }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDTRY.
IF lo_access->ms_error IS NOT INITIAL. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lo_access->ms_error-msgtx }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Set BOM header and trigger implicit explosion via data container ***************************************************************************************************************************************
"BOM header ls_item_data = VALUE #( handle = cl_system_uuid=>if_system_uuid_static~create_uuid_c32( ) material_id = 'SDBOMLUMFHD' order_qty = 3 category_code = 'TAP' item_id = '000010' sales_uom = 'PC' ).
ls_changed_field = VALUE #( handle = ls_item_data-handle field = VALUE #( ( if_goal_sdoc_item=>co_field_name-category_code ) ( if_goal_sdoc_item=>co_field_name-item_id ) ( if_goal_sdoc_item=>co_field_name-material_id ) ( if_goal_sdoc_item=>co_field_name-order_qty ) ( if_goal_sdoc_item=>co_field_name-sales_uom ) ) ).
APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data. APPEND ls_changed_field TO lt_changed_field.
" Fill the data container for the BOM explosion:
ls_item_cont-handle = ls_item_data-handle. ls_item_cont-bom_structure = VALUE #( bom_base_quantity = 1 bom_category = 'M' bom_number = '12345678' bom_key_date = sy-datum bom_usage = 5 ).
lt_bom_explosion = VALUE #( ( item_id = '000012' handle = cl_system_uuid=>if_system_uuid_static~create_uuid_c32( ) material_id = 'SDBOMLUMFIT01' bom_category = 'M' bom_number = '12345678' bom_item_node_number = '00000001' bom_internal_counter = '00000011' bom_usage = 5 bom_item_number = '0111' requested_quantity = 2 bom_component_quantity_uom = 'ST' "internal format required bom_component_quantity = 3 ) ( item_id = '000013' handle = cl_system_uuid=>if_system_uuid_static~create_uuid_c32( ) material_id = 'TG11' bom_category = 'M' bom_number = '12345678' bom_item_node_number = '00000002' bom_internal_counter = '00000012' bom_usage = 5 bom_item_number = '0112' requested_quantity = 3 bom_component_quantity_uom = 'ST' bom_component_quantity = 3 ) ).
ls_item_cont-bom_structure-bom_explosion = lt_bom_explosion.
lo_goal_sdoc_data_cont->add_item( EXPORTING is_item = ls_item_cont IMPORTING et_rejected_item = DATA(lt_rejected_item) ).
*not allowed to pass additional changes for components -> try to do it anyways
ls_item_data = VALUE #( handle = lt_bom_explosion[ 1 ]-handle category_code = 'CBXN' ).
ls_changed_field = VALUE #( handle = lt_bom_explosion[ 1 ]-handle field = VALUE #( ( if_goal_sdoc_item=>co_field_name-category_code ) ) ). APPEND ls_item_data TO lt_item_data. APPEND ls_changed_field TO lt_changed_field.
*Set header TRY. lo_access->set_entity_set( EXPORTING iv_entity_id = 'ITEM' it_entity_data = lt_item_data it_changed_field = lt_changed_field IMPORTING et_rejected_inst = lt_rejected_inst ). CATCH cx_goal_exc INTO lx_goal_exc. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lx_goal_exc->get_text( ) }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDTRY.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Check the result after the call ***************************************************************************************************************************************
IF lo_access->ms_error IS NOT INITIAL. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lo_access->ms_error-msgtx }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
IF lines( lt_rejected_inst ) <> 1 OR lt_rejected_inst[ 1 ]-handle <> lt_bom_explosion[ 1 ]-handle. lv_statement = 'Rejected instance not set correctly.'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*read the items lo_access->get_entity_set( EXPORTING iv_entity_id = 'ITEM' IMPORTING et_entity_data = lt_item_data ).
*perform validations IF lines( lt_item_data ) <> 3. lv_statement = 'Number of items not correct.'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
IF lt_item_data[ 2 ]-handle <> lt_bom_explosion[ 1 ]-handle OR lt_item_data[ 2 ]-item_id <> '000012' OR lt_item_data[ 2 ]-higher_level_item_id <> '000010' OR lt_item_data[ 2 ]-category_code = 'CBXN' OR lt_item_data[ 3 ]-handle <> lt_bom_explosion[ 2 ]-handle OR lt_item_data[ 3 ]-higher_level_item_id <> '000010' OR lt_item_data[ 3 ]-item_id <> '000013'. lv_statement = 'Items have not been created correctly.'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Provide additional item data for first component in a second call ***************************************************************************************************************************************
ls_item_data = VALUE #( handle = lt_bom_explosion[ 1 ]-handle category_code = 'CBXN' ).
ls_changed_field = VALUE #( handle = lt_bom_explosion[ 1 ]-handle field = VALUE #( ( if_goal_sdoc_item=>co_field_name-category_code ) ) ).
TRY. lo_access->set_entity( EXPORTING iv_entity_id = 'ITEM' is_entity_data = ls_item_data is_changed_field = ls_changed_field ). CATCH cx_goal_exc INTO lx_goal_exc. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lx_goal_exc->get_text( ) }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDTRY.
IF lo_access->ms_error IS NOT INITIAL. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lo_access->ms_error-msgtx }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
lo_access->get_entity_set( EXPORTING iv_entity_id = 'ITEM' IMPORTING et_entity_data = lt_item_data ).
IF lines( lt_item_data ) <> 3 OR lt_item_data[ 2 ]-category_code <> 'CBXN'. lv_statement = 'Item has not been changed correctly.'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
lo_access->save( IMPORTING ev_bo_key = lv_bo_key ).
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Check that save was successful ***************************************************************************************************************************************
IF lv_bo_key IS INITIAL. lv_statement = 'Error: Save not possible'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
rv_execution_status = abap_true. APPEND VALUE #( vbeln = lv_bo_key ) TO ev_document_id.

DATA: lv_statement TYPE string. DATA: lv_vbeln TYPE vbeln.
ev_immediate_exit = abap_true. rv_check_status = abap_false.
DATA(ls_step_data) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = iv_step_number ). IF lines( ls_step_data-reference_step ) = 1. DATA(ls_reference_step) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = ls_step_data-reference_step[ 1 ] ). IF ls_reference_step-document_id IS NOT INITIAL. lv_vbeln = ls_reference_step-document_id[ 1 ]. ENDIF. ENDIF. IF lv_vbeln IS INITIAL. lv_statement = 'Error: Document was not created successfully'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). RETURN. ENDIF.
SELECT * FROM vbap INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_vbap) WHERE vbeln = @lv_vbeln ORDER BY posnr.
READ TABLE lt_vbap INTO DATA(ls_vbap) INDEX 1. IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR ls_vbap-stlty <> 'M' OR ls_vbap-stlnr <> '12345678' OR ls_vbap-kmpmg <> 1. lv_statement = 'Error: Problem with BOM header'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). RETURN. ENDIF.
READ TABLE lt_vbap INTO ls_vbap INDEX 2. IF ls_vbap-matnr <> 'SDBOMLUMFIT01' OR ls_vbap-stlty <> 'M' OR ls_vbap-stlnr <> '12345678' OR ls_vbap-stkey <> 5 OR ls_vbap-stlkn <> '00000001' OR ls_vbap-stpoz <> '00000011' OR ls_vbap-kwmeng <> 2 OR ls_vbap-kmpmg <> 3. lv_statement = 'Error: Problem with BOM component 1'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). RETURN. ENDIF. READ TABLE lt_vbap INTO ls_vbap INDEX 3. IF ls_vbap-matnr <> 'TG11' OR ls_vbap-stlty <> 'M' OR ls_vbap-stlnr <> '12345678' OR ls_vbap-stkey <> 5 OR ls_vbap-stlkn <> '00000002' OR ls_vbap-stpoz <> '00000012' OR ls_vbap-kwmeng <> 3 OR ls_vbap-kmpmg <> 3. lv_statement = 'Error: Problem with BOM component 2'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). RETURN. ENDIF.
rv_check_status = abap_true.

item.VAR_DESC: GOAL: Create order and pass address_guid of SP on head

item.CODE:
DATA: lo_access TYPE REF TO if_goal_access. DATA: ls_changed_field TYPE if_goal_types=>tcs_changed_field. DATA: lt_changed_field TYPE if_goal_types=>tct_changed_field. DATA: lv_field TYPE fieldname. DATA: lx_goal_exc TYPE REF TO cx_goal_exc. DATA: lv_text_exc TYPE string. DATA: lt_handle_reuse TYPE if_goal_types=>tct_handle_reuse. DATA: lv_handle_head TYPE if_goal_types=>tcd_handle. DATA: lv_bo_key TYPE if_goal_types=>tcd_bo_key. DATA: ls_head_data TYPE tds_goal_so_head. DATA: ls_item_data TYPE tds_goal_so_item. DATA: ls_party_data TYPE tds_goal_basic_party, lt_party_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tds_goal_basic_party. DATA: ls_load_param TYPE cl_goal_salesorder=>tcs_load_parameter. DATA: lv_statement TYPE string.
ev_immediate_exit = abap_true.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Determine (non-default) Adress GUIDs for BPs S10103280 and S10103282 (these BPs should have multiple addresses) ***************************************************************************************************************************************
SELECT but020~partner, but020~address_guid, but020~addrnumber FROM but020 INNER JOIN adrc ON but020~addrnumber = adrc~addrnumber WHERE but020~partner = 'S10103280' AND but020~addr_valid_from > @sy-datum AND but020~addr_valid_to > @sy-datum AND adrc~pers_addr <> 'X' INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_addresses).
SELECT addrnumber FROM but021_fs WHERE partner = 'S10103280' AND adr_kind = 'XXDEFAULT' INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_exclude).
LOOP AT lt_exclude INTO DATA(ls_exclude). DELETE lt_addresses WHERE addrnumber = ls_exclude-addrnumber. ENDLOOP.
IF lines( lt_addresses ) < 2. lv_statement = 'BP S10103280 hat fewer addresses than expected -> Check master data -> Test cannot be exectued'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Create Sales Order by providing Sold-To-Party and Address GUID ***************************************************************************************************************************************
ls_load_param-type_code = 'OR'. ls_load_param-sales_organization_id = '1010'. ls_load_param-distribution_channel_id = '10'. ls_load_param-division_id = '00'.
TRY. CALL METHOD cl_goal_api=>so_instance->create EXPORTING iv_bo_id = if_goal_sdoc=>co_bo_id-salesorder is_load_parameter = ls_load_param RECEIVING ro_access = lo_access. lv_handle_head = cl_goal_util=>so_instance->create_guid( ). APPEND VALUE #( entity_id = 'HEAD' handle = lv_handle_head ) TO lt_handle_reuse. lo_access->set_handle_reuse( lt_handle_reuse ). CATCH cx_goal_exc INTO lx_goal_exc. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lx_goal_exc->get_text( ) }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDTRY.
CLEAR ls_head_data. ls_head_data-handle = lv_handle_head. ls_head_data-sold_to_party_id = 'S10103280'. ls_head_data-sold_to_party_address_guid = lt_addresses[ 1 ]-address_guid.
CLEAR ls_changed_field. ls_changed_field-handle = ls_head_data-handle. lv_field = 'SOLD_TO_PARTY_ID'. INSERT lv_field INTO TABLE ls_changed_field-field. lv_field = 'SOLD_TO_PARTY_ADDRESS_GUID'. INSERT lv_field INTO TABLE ls_changed_field-field.
CALL METHOD lo_access->set_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id is_entity_data = ls_head_data is_changed_field = ls_changed_field.
IF lo_access->ms_error IS NOT INITIAL. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lo_access->ms_error-msgtx }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
* get HEAD Party CALL METHOD lo_access->get_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id iv_index = 1 IMPORTING es_entity_data = ls_head_data.
IF ls_head_data-sold_to_party_address_guid <> lt_addresses[ 1 ]-address_guid. lv_statement = 'Address GUID during Create of Sold To + Address GUID not set correctly'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Change address guid only ***************************************************************************************************************************************
CLEAR ls_head_data. ls_head_data-handle = lv_handle_head. ls_head_data-sold_to_party_address_guid = lt_addresses[ 2 ]-address_guid.
CLEAR ls_changed_field. ls_changed_field-handle = ls_head_data-handle. lv_field = 'SOLD_TO_PARTY_ADDRESS_GUID'. INSERT lv_field INTO TABLE ls_changed_field-field.
CALL METHOD lo_access->set_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id is_entity_data = ls_head_data is_changed_field = ls_changed_field.
IF lo_access->ms_error IS NOT INITIAL. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lo_access->ms_error-msgtx }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
* get HEAD Party CALL METHOD lo_access->get_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id iv_index = 1 IMPORTING es_entity_data = ls_head_data. IF ls_head_data-sold_to_party_address_guid <> lt_addresses[ 2 ]-address_guid. lv_statement = 'Address GUID during change of Address GUID (only) not set correctly'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Change now to some "dummy" sold-to-party (to be able to change back later) ***************************************************************************************************************************************
CLEAR ls_head_data. ls_head_data-handle = lv_handle_head. ls_head_data-sold_to_party_id = '10100001'.
CLEAR ls_changed_field. ls_changed_field-handle = ls_head_data-handle. lv_field = 'SOLD_TO_PARTY_ID'. INSERT lv_field INTO TABLE ls_changed_field-field.
CALL METHOD lo_access->set_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id is_entity_data = ls_head_data is_changed_field = ls_changed_field.
IF lo_access->ms_error IS NOT INITIAL. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lo_access->ms_error-msgtx }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Change sold-to-party and address guid ***************************************************************************************************************************************
CLEAR ls_head_data. ls_head_data-handle = lv_handle_head. ls_head_data-sold_to_party_id = 'S10103280'. ls_head_data-sold_to_party_address_guid = lt_addresses[ 1 ]-address_guid.
CLEAR ls_changed_field. ls_changed_field-handle = ls_head_data-handle. lv_field = 'SOLD_TO_PARTY_ID'. INSERT lv_field INTO TABLE ls_changed_field-field. lv_field = 'SOLD_TO_PARTY_ADDRESS_GUID'. INSERT lv_field INTO TABLE ls_changed_field-field.
CALL METHOD lo_access->set_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id is_entity_data = ls_head_data is_changed_field = ls_changed_field.
IF lo_access->ms_error IS NOT INITIAL. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lo_access->ms_error-msgtx }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
* get HEAD Party CALL METHOD lo_access->get_entity EXPORTING iv_entity_id = if_goal_sdoc_head=>co_entity_id iv_index = 1 IMPORTING es_entity_data = ls_head_data.
IF ls_head_data-sold_to_party_address_guid <> lt_addresses[ 1 ]-address_guid OR ls_head_data-sold_to_party_id <> 'S10103280'. lv_statement = 'Change of address guid + sold to party did not work as expected.'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Save ***************************************************************************************************************************************
lo_access->save( IMPORTING ev_bo_key = lv_bo_key ).
*************************************************************************************************************************************** *Check that save was successful ***************************************************************************************************************************************
IF lv_bo_key IS INITIAL. lv_statement = 'Error: Save not possible'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). rv_execution_status = abap_false. RETURN. ENDIF.
rv_execution_status = abap_true. APPEND VALUE #( vbeln = lv_bo_key ) TO ev_document_id.

DATA: lv_statement TYPE string. DATA: lv_vbeln TYPE vbeln.
ev_immediate_exit = abap_true. rv_check_status = abap_false.
DATA(ls_step_data) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = iv_step_number ). IF lines( ls_step_data-reference_step ) = 1. DATA(ls_reference_step) = io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->get_step_data( iv_step_number = ls_step_data-reference_step[ 1 ] ). IF ls_reference_step-document_id IS NOT INITIAL. lv_vbeln = ls_reference_step-document_id[ 1 ]. ENDIF. ENDIF. IF lv_vbeln IS INITIAL. lv_statement = 'Error: Document was not created successfully'. io_ptf_bo->mo_run_environment->append_log( iv_log_statement = |{ lv_statement }| ). RETURN. ENDIF. rv_check_status = abap_true.
